name: Alaska caselaw — CAP jurisdiction collection — 1887–2019 (part-0001)
description: 10749 historical CAP case records, selected by CAP's jurisdiction label. Part of Alaska caselaw — CAP jurisdiction collection; see the collection index for complete coverage. Preserves CAP's Alaska jurisdiction assignment, including 21 U.S. District Court for the District of Alaska records printed in Federal Supplement, Third Series. Court names remain explicit; this is not exclusively state-court material. OCR may contain errors; inclusion does not establish current legal authority.
